answer: Transactions & Dealings >> Shares & Investments Question ID: 1517 Country: India Title: Is it permissible in Islam to invest in mutual funds? Question: Is it permissible in Islam to invest in mutual funds? Answer ID: 1517 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 615/611=N) It is allowed to invest in such mutual funds which invest the money of shareholders in companies which deal only in halal items and which have already started their business i.e. they are established and their asset is not only liquid. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
